impact_benefits.detail: Prevents CO2 emissions, eliminates marine fuel spill risk
Saves crores in diesel subsidy & fuel transport logistics
Uninterrupted power to homes, hospitals, schools, desalination plants
Protects islands from monsoon fuel supply disruptions

references.text: PyPSA (Brown, Hörsch & Schlachtberger, 2018) — open-source power system optimization toolbox
TOPSIS (Hwang & Yoon, 1981) — MCDA ranking method
OTEC Cold-Water-Pipe Losses (Aresti et al., ICTAM 2024) — heat loss & parasitic pumping model
Li-ion Capacity Fade at High Temp (Carnovale & Li, 2020) — SEI-growth driven battery degradation
NIOT OTEC-Desalination Plant, Kavaratti — operational reference (29°C surface vs 5°C deep-sea)
